name: Git Repositories (MCP)
author: JARVIS Core
description: Official MCP git server (Python/uvx): read, search and inspect git repositories from chat. Scanned read-mostly; every tool call is explicit.
capabilities: show status, log and diffs of a repository
search commit history and file blame

examples.phrase: what changed in my last commit
examples.reply: The git tool shows the HEAD commit's diff from your repository root.
